tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page and popup list ground.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Sidebar, popup hint bar, segmented-control track.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Ground of secondary buttons, selects, tag chips and the create form fields (shadcn secondary and muted). Sunk in light, one step raised in dark so controls stay visible on the dark shell.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, dialogs, the hover preview card. Always with a line edge.

tokens.name: segment-active
tokens.usage: The raised tile of the active segment in the theme switch; the track is surface-sunk.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: The popup's pack and Pinned header bands. One step heavier than hover in both modes, so a row under the pointer never reads as a header.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Mouse hover on rows and ghost buttons. Never the keyboard selection colour.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Keyboard-selected list row fill in the popup and sidebar; text stays ink.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy and row titles on surface-0, surface-sunk, surface-raised and selection.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: prompt first lines, pack names, counts. 4.5:1 on all surfaces in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Hints, placeholders, micro-labels. 4.5:1 on surface-0 and surface-sunk in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Every hairline edge: rows, cards, kbd, menus.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input edges, the popup shell edge, the segmented-control track edge. Decorative, about 1.6:1 on surface-0: state is carried by the focus ring and fills, never by this edge alone.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, match highlighting, the active segment label. Text only, never a fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring outside the control on :focus-visible. 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: btn-primary
tokens.usage: The one primary button fill: Paste, Apply, Import.

tokens.name: on-btn-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icon on btn-primary.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive text on danger-soft and surface-0; the confirmed-delete fill; error status text.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Resting fill under danger text on destructive buttons.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Pins, locks, the unset-config warning strip. Text and icon on surface-0 and surface-sunk.

tokens.name: heading
tokens.usage: Module titles (Prompt, Preview, Settings cards) and group titles: ink-2, so structure reads from weight and placement, never from the accent (Ink first, hue second).

tokens.name: heading-strong
tokens.usage: Pack titles: ink, one step above group and module titles by weight and colour.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Saved and Pasted confirmations, text only, on surface-0.

tokens.name: code-ground
tokens.usage: The popup's hover preview card: where a prompt's text is read whole. Instrument keeps it on surface-raised; Indigo drops it to the file's code-block ground.

tokens.name: param-builtin
tokens.usage: {clipboard}, {date}, {time} chip text on param-builtin-soft.

tokens.name: param-builtin-soft
tokens.usage: Ground under a built-in placeholder chip and inserted clipboard text in the preview.

tokens.name: param-field
tokens.usage: Fill-in field chip text on param-field-soft, and the field label in the popup form.

tokens.name: param-field-soft
tokens.usage: Ground under a fill-in field chip and a filled value in the preview.

tokens.name: param-config
tokens.usage: Config parameter chip text on param-config-soft. Orchid, so it no longer reads as the accent.

tokens.name: param-config-soft
tokens.usage: Ground under a config parameter chip.

tokens.name: panel-head
tokens.usage: The expandable panel's head: the ground a pack frame's header, the editor's Prompt title line and a Settings pack card's name sit on. Kept equal to surface-raised by hand (the file holds no aliases): change the two together.

tokens.name: panel-body
tokens.usage: The panel's body under the head, a step up in dark and sunk in light: the rows under a pack header, the Prompt field, a pack card's details. Kept equal to control by hand: change the two together.

tokens.name: panel-edge
tokens.usage: The panel's edge, 1 px. None in Instrument (no line around a panel anywhere, 2026-10-10); Indigo's line.

families.sans: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text in inputs, settings rows, dialogs.
styles.sample: Copy an error, hit the hotkey, pick Root cause first.

styles.name: row-title
styles.usage: Prompt title in popup rows and the sidebar.

styles.name: row-meta
styles.usage: Prompt first line, pack name, counts, in ink-2.
styles.sample: Given the stack trace below, find the root cause before proposing a fix.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Section headers in the popup list and sidebar, uppercase via CSS, in ink-3. The only uppercase style.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Window and panel titles, the editor title input.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Dialog headings and empty-state headings. Nothing larger exists.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Placeholder tokens, prompt bodies in the preview card, kbd keys.

styles.name: mono-hint
styles.usage: The popup's bottom hint bar, in ink-3.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and icons inside a row.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Row horizontal padding, gap between controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card and menu padding, popup shell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Dialog padding, settings section gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between settings sections and around empty states.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, inputs, selects, the sidebar's rows and a Compact popup row. A Comfortable popup row is two lines (title, then the first line of the prompt) at 44px; the popup search input is 32px.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Chips, tag pills, kbd.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, list rows, the selection fill.

tokens.name: radius-3
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, dialogs, the preview card.

tokens.name: radius-4
tokens.usage: The popup shell only; the file's window corners.

tokens.name: radius-search
tokens.usage: The two search boxes, the field each window is built around. Instrument keeps them at radius-2; Indigo makes them pills.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: The popup shell, paired with a line-strong edge.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Context menus, the hover preview card, the Tab action panel.

tokens.name: shadow-segment
tokens.usage: Under the active segment tile only.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Under the overview's prompt cards: a soft glow out from the edge so they float a little off the pane (2026-10-10). Nothing else at rest.

tokens.name: chip-tint
tokens.usage: How much of a tag's hue a resting chip's ground carries (color-mix with transparent). Chips are tinted grounds, never outlines.

tokens.name: chip-edge
tokens.usage: How much of a tag's hue a resting chip's edge carries. 0% in Instrument: an edge marks a state only (tag-fill). Indigo's state pills are tint plus edge.
